title: matricaria rotundifolia
intro: Matricaria rotundifolia, commonly known as German chamomile, is a flowering plant in the daisy family, native to Europe and Western Asia. The health benefits of German chamomile include its ability to reduce anxiety and insomnia, soothe digestive issues, and alleviate menstrual cramps. Its therapeutic actions include acting as a sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it effective in treating various health conditions. German chamomile contains bioactive constituents such as apigenin, luteolin, and chamazulene, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
